No Go, tests, helpers, format/lint, scanners/parsers, process/resource probes, locks, privilege, cloud, signing/crypto, TerraBase or downloads executed. Git/file reads, hashes and metadata serialization only.

Embedded fixtures call real project Start; its controller/system protocol clients use nats.InProcessServer. Host reconnect uses actual loopback TCP/mTLS through a bridge and blackhole proxy. Neither qualifies regional networking, VM TAP behavior or production deployment.

Filesystem identity tests use temporary real files, descriptors, metadata and production publication/readback; they do not qualify crash/power-loss durability, real service accounts or a running production JetStream data store.

Leaf credential and interregion predicate cases do not prove peer-server admission or leaf network behavior. Fixture JWT/TLS file setup remains incidental to their local schema/contract assertions.
